description.text: The Master's Program of International Journalism and Communication cultivates professionals with global vision and strategic mindset. It not only equips students with humanistic knowledge and journalism theories, but also practical skills such as news interviewing, writing, editing, filming and reporting. Graduated students will be fully competent for working in the field of International Journalism and Communication. The Major of Journalism at the School of Television and Journalism of Communication University of China is one of the best in the country. Adding to the excellent faculty team and teaching resources, renowned professionals are invited to give students instructions on their practice. Courses Below is the listing of part of the courses that are planned to be offered: International Journalism Practice Historical Theory of International Journalism International Relations and Public Diplomacy International Journalism Writing and Commentary TV Editing and Directing TV News Program Studies TV Interview Studies TV Image Language Non-linear Editing System

duration.text: The International Journalism and Communication at Communication University of China is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.

requirements.text: Applicant must have Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant field. Applicant should be under 35 years of age (include 35). For applicant whose native language is not English, English proficiency should be enough for graduate level study and thesis writing. Please submit TOEFL or IELTS test score if available.
